card.name: Linking words in old legal prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, the, by, of, in, for, as) inside long formal sentences from historical legal or constitutional texts, especially in the Militia clause quotations.

modes.label: Militia clause wording
modes.description: Linking words inside the quoted constitutional text about training and governing the Militia.
modes.example: the Authority of training the Militia according<< to>> the discipline prescribed by Congress.

modes.label: Old legal argument
modes.description: Linking words or verbs inside 18th and 19th century legal or judicial argument.
